text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's that couple who treated me at the cafe the other day! 
Ehehe, hey there...—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, h-huh...?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I'll leave you here. 
I'm heading home. ...Take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Same to you. 
...I'll come back for my luggage later.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Huh...? 
What's the matter with both of you...!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
M-Missss! 
What on earth happened to youuu!?

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, about the other day. 
No, we just... had a little fight.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
A fight?! 
But just the other day, you seemed like such good friends...!

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, back then— 
we hadn't started living together yet. 
...Living with someone really is tough, huh.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey! We're not done—and she's gone. 
Geez, what was that all about?!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Mister, what happened!? 
I heard you got into a fight...

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...A fight is more like a result, I guess. 
The cause surely isn't there, though.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...I think I probably 
made you hold back.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hold back? ...But big brother, 
you were trying to learn so much 
about Umamusume--about me, your big sister, weren't you!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I thought I tried my best, but... 
To an Umamusume—to her—it seems 
humans look pretty frail.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"It's dangerous, so I'll do it" seemed to be her catchphrase. 
Rather than sharing duties... I feel like 
she saw me as unreliable.

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
And lately, she's been pinning her ears back 
while saying "it's nothing" a lot more often.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...That definitely doesn't sound like "nothing."

text_block_list.name: Gentle Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Right? But she won't talk to me. 
...She must have kept her frustration bottled up.

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
...Because of my tail, 
I took a long time at the bathroom sink. For him, 
that was probably a subtle source of stress.

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
And things like the AC temperature. He likes it warm, 
but I get hot pretty easily... 
It was little things like that piling up, you know.

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text:
I got all fired up to do some heavy lifting to make up for it... 
He didn't look too pleased, though... 
It felt like he was holding back a grimace the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? That's what your brother said too, you know?

text_block_list.name: A mature Umamusume.
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Big brother thinks he's making big sister hold back, 
and big sister thinks she's making big brother 
hold back...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Aha... I think I've got it. 
Hey, come over here!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Here, hehe. That carrot juice from back then~!

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Th-Thank you... Um, what do you mean by 
you understood?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Look, you know how you said 'it feels 
like he's holding back'?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Did you actually say that to him?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...I think you're both just really kind 
people. Even if you think 'huh?', you just 
accept it and go along with each other, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
'He's enduring it, so I should endure it 
too.' ...Didn't you think something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Y-Yeah. I thought that's just what 
it meant for two different people to live 
together...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...But you two are different! And when 
things are different, I think it's okay to 
ask!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
When I saw you two before, you looked so 
happy despite your differences. I'm sure 
you could've overcome those differences 
together.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, why not ask how he really feels? 
Breaking up just like this would be so 
lonely...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
You were drawn to each other despite being 
different, right? You felt like you wanted 
to walk together side-by-side, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...Something like that... surely doesn't 
happen many times in life.

text_block_list.name: Adult Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Would you laugh if I said I'm scared? 
But you're right. I have to try asking 
him...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
...All right! In that case, let's pick a 
day to talk!! Once you do, Buu will go 
tell your boyfriend...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. I ran into Blast Onepiece in the 
library, earnestly looking something up.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Hehe... Getting to know each other and 
getting along! This is prep for that!
choice_data_list: 何を張り切っているの？
choice_data_list_en: What are you so fired up about?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I picked up the memo, and...—

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Ah, t-that's a misunderstanding! It's not 
Buu! It's not for Buu!!
